questions.questionText:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III.
Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with
commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.
Statements:
All hens are eggs.
All birds are eggs.
All eggs are lions.
Conclusions:
I. All hens are lions.
II. Some lions are eggs.
III. All birds are lions.
options: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (D).
